title: Vapir Prima Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Vapir Prima Portable Vaporizer

NEW KITS
90 DAY WARRANTY

A solid compact portable vaporizer that is super easy to use and produces really good vapor. Swappable battery and external charger means you can always have a charged battery ready to go.

We have been using the Vapir Prima since its release and it is still one of our go to portable vaporizers.

Features:

- Truly Portable, easy to bring everywhere.

- 4 pre-set temperatures

- Unprecedented Vapor Flavor and Density

- Stainless steel vapor path

- Brushed Aluminum Body

- Multiple Colors

- Sleek, Stylish and Exceptional Design

- Removable, Lithium Battery

- High quality heating element

- 60 Day Unit Warranty

- 30 Day Battery Warranty

The Vapir Prima Kit Includes:
Prima, Prima Battery Charger/Power Supply, Charging Cord, Cap Sleeve, Mesh Screens, Scoop, Cap Screens, Plug Brush, and Cleaning Tool.

BONUS ITEMS: 2 TOP SCREENS, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 CLEANING BRUSH
